name: Return to Valanaar

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you share the defenders' and leaders' ties to the four winds, reflected in their blessing.

aliases: who sends you back to valanaar
faq.answer: Yorna sends you to Valanaar after the outpost's hard-fought defense. She asks you to carry a report to the settlement's leaders.
You report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. She awaits news of the outlying defenders and their safety.
faq.q: Who do you report to in Valanaar?

faq.answer: Yorna's Report says the defenders have stabilized their position and are clearing away the attackers who remain.
Yorna and her forces defended the eastern watchtower, a key position watching the approaches to Valanaar.
The defenders have secured the eastern watchtower and stabilized the situation. They are still clearing away attackers who remain.
faq.q: What is the status of the eastern watchtower?

aliases: may the four winds bless you
faq.answer: The defenders of Valanaar honor the four winds and the elements. Their blessing and Valennia's thanks to the winds show that reverence.
faq.q: Why do the defenders speak of the four winds?

sections.body: After the attack on the outpost, Yorna sends word to Valanaar. The attackers have been broken, and the defenders are clearing away those who remain. You carry Yorna's Report to ease the leaders waiting in town for news.
sections.title: Word from the Outpost

sections.body: You bring the eastern watchtower's report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar. The tower has held, and its perimeter is stable. Valennia gives thanks to the winds, relieved that the frontier remains secure.
sections.title: Relief in Valanaar

summary: Yorna's report brings word to Valanaar that the eastern watchtower has held. Its perimeter is stable, and the remaining attackers are being cleared away.
attribution: In-game quest text: Return to Valanaar
